description: Data Protection Impact Assessment exists but does not contain required elements specified in Article 35.7, including systematic description of processing, necessity assessment, risk assessment, or mitigation measures.
applicability: Applicable to all DPIAs conducted under Article 35. Documentation must include processing description, necessity and proportionality assessment, risk assessment, and safeguards.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of existing DPIA documentation for completeness against Article 35.7 requirements.
